weapon.quote: died from a .12 bore gun- shot which could not be ascribed to rifles
weapon.reason: Omits the .12 bore gun, which is the weapon that killed the deceased.

trial_court_outcome.quote: acquittal dated 13.12.2011 passed by the third Additional District & Sessions Judge

high_court_outcome.correct_value: Delay condoned; leave to appeal rejected; Government Appeal dismissed
high_court_outcome.quote: the application seeking leave to appeal... was rejected and in consequence the Government Appeal was dismissed
high_court_outcome.reason: High Court did have an outcome: leave rejected and appeal dismissed, not 'not applicable'.

final_outcome.reason: Supreme Court dismissed the appeal, leaving acquittal intact.

offence_finally_established.reason: No offence was finally established given the acquittal stands.

neutral_facts.correct_value: Three policemen allegedly fired on a scooter carrying the deceased at night; two witnesses on another scooter said torchlight caused a skid and shots followed; only some cartridges matched the accused's rifles; a .12 bore gun caused the death. Omit trial and appeal outcomes.
neutral_facts.quote: which were matched to the rifles of the accused... leading to the acquittal of the accused... The High Court dismissed the appeal
neutral_facts.reason: Overstates cartridge matching (only some matched) and reveals the acquittal and High Court dismissal.

offence_severity.reason: No punishment range for section 302 is stated in the judgment.

attempt_completion.quote: he succumbed to his injuries on the way
attempt_completion.reason: Victim died, so the offence was completed.

physical_harm.quote: the deceased did not die of a rifle bullet injury. Rather, he died from a .12 bore gun- shot
physical_harm.reason: Death from a .12 bore gunshot, not a rifle bullet, is stated.

number_of_offences.correct_value: One offence (murder, s.302 r/w s.34) charged against three accused; no conviction upheld
number_of_offences.quote: charged Anil Kumar, Shyam Bihari and Arshad Ali... for committing offence punishable under Section 302
number_of_offences.reason: Only one offence was charged, and none was upheld; 'three upheld' contradicts the acquittal.

financial_property_loss.reason: No financial or property loss is discussed in the judgment.

premeditation_planning.reason: No premeditation or planning is stated in the judgment.

motive.quote: there was no proven motive to commit such an act
motive.reason: Motive is not identified; the judgment notes no proven motive.

key_evidence_accepted.correct_value: Witnesses consistent that police action occurred that night; .12 bore gunshot not ascribable to service rifles; no reliable evidence fire was meant to kill
key_evidence_accepted.quote: the witnesses are consistent that there was a police action on that fateful night
key_evidence_accepted.reason: Court did not accept the ocular account; it only noted consistency of police action and the .12 bore finding.

witness_credibility.correct_value: PW-15 found unreliable (silence, identical affidavits, lying about going alone); PW-3 and PW-6 found of little help as they could not identify accused
witness_credibility.quote: PW-3 and PW-6 were found inconsequential as they could not identify the accused
witness_credibility.reason: Overgeneralises that main witnesses were unreliable; PW-3 and PW-6 were found unhelpful, not shown unreliable.

post_offence_conduct.correct_value: Accused remained at the spot after the incident; police set up a cross version (Case Crime No.48A/87); PW-15 delayed disclosure
post_offence_conduct.quote: the continued presence of the accused at the spot is a circumstance which goes in favour of the accused
post_offence_conduct.reason: Post-incident conduct is discussed: continued presence at spot and the cross version case.
